mapper.select: SELECT user_id, points, total_points, continuous_days, total_check_in_days, last_check_in_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_points WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_points (user_id, points, total_points, continuous_days, total_check_in_days) VALUES (#{userId}, 0, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_points SET points = points + #{delta}, total_points = total_points + #{delta}, continuous_days = #{continuousDays}, total_check_in_days = #{totalCheckInDays}, last_check_in_at = #{lastCheckInAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
